trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours, there is no extra task. Work the roadmap in order and it arrives on its own; the last trophy you earn decides when it unlocks.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Follow the Roadmap tab stage by stage.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the 54th lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, teaches the basics and ends with your first trophy. It cannot be missed, just play through the intro.
steps: Start a new game and play the intro.
Follow the on-screen prompts through Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 sets up Lucia and Jason's return to Vice City. Play every story mission in order; side content is optional for this one, but the missable trophy lives in this chapter, so read its guide first.
steps: Play Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Before the chapter's final mission, finish the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Complete the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 widens the map and the crew. Keep to the story missions; the chapter trophy pops when the last one ends.
steps: Play Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Stock up on ammo and armour before the bigger shootouts.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is Vice City proper, heists, chases and the city at full volume. Expect longer missions and more driving.
steps: Play Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Use fast travel and safehouses to cut downtime.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 raises the stakes toward the finale. Missions get tougher; bring your best weapons and keep a manual save before the big jobs.
steps: Play Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Keep a manual save before each major mission.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The finale. It is long, so clear an evening, keep a manual save at its start, and play it through, the gold pops at the credits.
steps: Keep a manual save before starting the final mission.
Play the finale through to the credits.
The gold trophy unlocks at the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: An early story mission and a quick trophy. Follow the mission markers and it pops at the end.
steps: Start the Breakfast Run mission.
Follow the markers and finish the objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Your first big heist. It mixes driving, shooting and a getaway, take it steady and the trophy follows.
steps: Start The Cartel Heist.
Complete each heist objective in order.
Escape clean and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story mission with a lighter touch. Follow it through and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Start the Child's Play mission.
Complete its objectives.
The trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A loud mission with a big set piece. Keep moving, use cover, and finish the objectives.
steps: Start the Headliners mission.
Work through the set-piece objectives.
The trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A takedown at the airport. Expect a chase and a shootout, a fast car and a full clip help.
steps: Start the VCIA Takedown mission.
Complete the takedown objectives.
The trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A heavy combat mission. Armour up, bring rifles, and use cover, the trophy pops when the operation ends.
steps: Stock armour and rifle ammo first.
Start Operation Savage Glory.
Finish every objective to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion tracks story, activities, collectibles and challenges together. Use the in-game checklist and this guide's remaining-time totals to mop up the last few percent, it is the last big gold for most players.
steps: Finish the story and all side strands.
Clear every collectible set and activity in this guide.
Check the in-game 100% tracker; the gold pops at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts count jumps, near misses, airtime and more. The count climbs fast in free roam, bikes and fast cars on the highways are the quickest way to 250.
steps: Grab a fast bike or car.
Chain jumps, near misses and airtime on highways.
Watch the counter; it pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types across Leonida, races, fishing, arcade games, drone races and more. Try one of each and the trophy pops.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu.
Try one of each of the 9 types.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 Shooting Range challenges, all gold. Learn each range's rhythm, use the right weapon per challenge, and retry the awkward ones, gold needs clean, fast runs.
steps: Visit every Shooting Range location.
Learn each challenge's target pattern.
Gold all 42 challenges; the trophy pops on the last.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 drone race locations. Learn each course's line, cut corners where the gates allow, and win them one by one.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race spots.
Learn each course and win the race.
The trophy pops after the 14th win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: 20 different races across Leonida, street, off-road, bike and boat. Vary the vehicle per race and keep a list of the ones you have won.
steps: Enter races across the map.
Win 20 different ones (repeats do not count).
The trophy pops on the 20th win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival. Match his catch with steady reeling, do not yank the line when the fish runs.
steps: Start the fishing challenge against Cal.
Reel steadily and manage the line tension.
Beat his catch to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade game counts. Pick the shortest cabinet, learn its controls, and finish one run.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play any game to completion.
The trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's last mission. It unlocks after his earlier strand, play his missions in order and the finale opens up.
steps: Complete Andy's earlier missions.
Start his final mission.
Finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's finale. Finish his strand in order; the last mission is a boat-heavy job, so keep a fast boat handy.
steps: Complete Kenton's earlier missions.
Start his final mission.
Finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's finale. His strand builds to a solo ride, play his missions in order and the last one opens.
steps: Complete Billy's earlier missions.
Start his final mission.
Finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: 8 stranger strands scattered across the state. Each is a short chain, meet the stranger, do their jobs, and the strand closes.
steps: Find stranger markers across Leonida.
Complete all 8 strands.
The trophy pops after the eighth strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's finale. His strand is about supply runs, finish his missions in order and the last one opens.
steps: Complete Randy's earlier missions.
Start his final mission.
Finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's finale. Play his strand in order; the last mission wraps his story.
steps: Complete Tyrone's earlier missions.
Start his final mission.
Finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY CONFIRMED MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot across Leonida, 18 spots, COUNT UNCONFIRMED. The first spot is the Chapter 1 balcony: keep a MANUAL Chapter 1 save before the balcony scene, because once Chapter 1 ends you cannot go back to it. Visit every other spot as you explore; the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: Keep a manual save in Chapter 1 before the balcony meditation.
Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot.
Meditate at every remaining spot across Leonida.
The trophy pops at the last spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants one unique animal. Track it in its habitat, approach quietly, and take the shot clean.
steps: Talk to Bret to start the hunt.
Track the unique animal in its habitat.
Hunt it clean to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: 3 full card sets, COUNT UNCONFIRMED. Cards hide in shops, houses and odd corners across Leonida, check every interior and use the map markers once a set is started.
steps: Find cards across Leonida's interiors.
Complete one full set, then the next.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: The longest collectible grind: WAiNK It at 100 locations, COUNT UNCONFIRMED. Work district by district and tick each spot off, this is the difficulty-5 marathon of the list.
steps: Open the WAiNK map and pick a district.
WAiNK It at every marked location there.
Repeat district by district until 100; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 50 challenges across every system, driving, shooting, flying, collectibles. They tick over naturally; the last few are worth hunting deliberately.
steps: Play normally and watch the challenge counter.
Chase the remaining challenge types deliberately.
The trophy pops at 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then lose it together. Break line of sight, swap cars, and hide until the stars fade.
steps: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
Break line of sight and swap vehicles.
Escape until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row with your partner, wanted level intact throughout. Plan the route, hit fast, and do not let the cops spot you between shops.
steps: Plan a route past three shops.
Rob each one back-to-back with your partner.
Keep your wanted level through all three.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: 100 different vehicles discovered, drive, steal and photograph your way through Leonida's traffic. Rare spawns are the slow part; check the usual spawn spots.
steps: Drive and enter every new vehicle you see.
Hunt the rare spawns at their usual spots.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time, group five enemies, trigger it, and drop them all before it ends. A tight alley or doorway helps.
steps: Find a spot with five enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down all five in the one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA without a ticket, an unscheduled departure. The airfield has more than one way out if you look for it.
steps: Get into VCIA.
Find an unscheduled way out.
Leave the airport to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos, tanks. Deal with them on your terms: heavy weapons, distance, and cover. The trophy pops once you have handled the Rhino situation.
steps: Find a Rhino encounter.
Use heavy weapons and cover.
Finish the encounter to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry job: no alarms, no witnesses. Go at night, move quietly, and leave before anyone notices.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and go at night.
Rob it without tripping alarms.
Leave undetected to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, five escapes. Plan each getaway, a fast car parked close to the exit is half the job.
steps: Rob a bank vault.
Escape clean.
Repeat for all five vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, crack it, and get away before the response arrives. A quiet road makes it easier.
steps: Find an armored truck on a quiet road.
Stop it and rob it.
Escape to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: All 52 areas of Leonida, COUNT UNCONFIRMED. Drive every road, visit every district, and watch the area counter, the last undiscovered corner is usually a small one.
steps: Drive through every district of Leonida.
Check the area counter as you go.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, nine illegal operations. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on, the trophy pops after the ninth.
steps: Locate each gang's illegal operation.
Rob one operation per gang.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet story moment on Ocean Beach. Sit, order the cocktail, and enjoy the view, the trophy pops as the scene plays.
steps: Reach the Ocean Beach scene in the story.
Order the cocktail.
Enjoy the view; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into the showroom, then smash your way out through the glass. Classic style means loud and fast.
steps: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom.
Smash out through the front.
The trophy pops as you escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A game at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley. Bowl a full game, follow-through counts, so finish every frame.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game.
Finish every frame to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A story beat about the partnership's public moment. Play through the scene and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach the partnership scene in the story.
Play through it.
The trophy pops at the scene's end.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices across the story, tracked to 500 by PSN. Make choices as you play, big and small, and the count climbs to the trophy.
steps: Make story choices as you play.
Keep choosing across missions.
The trophy pops when the count is reached.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail once, succeed the second time. It pops on a second attempt after a first failure, the game tracks it for you.
steps: Fail an attempt at something.
Try again right away.
Succeed on the second try to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange is out there in Leonida. Go looking in the odd corners of the map and the trophy pops when you witness it.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners.
Find the strange event.
Witness it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by that bowls someone over. Line up the target, swing from a moving vehicle, and connect.
steps: Find a target on foot.
Drive by and swing a melee weapon.
Knock them over to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies, funnel them through contacts steadily.
steps: Earn marked bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across Leonida's shops, clothes, weapons, food, cars. It adds up fast once the money flows.
steps: Earn money from missions and activities.
Spend across shops of every kind.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They cost real money, so save up and buy them as you can afford them.
steps: Save money from missions and activities.
Buy each garage property.
The trophy pops when the eighth is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app, and register each one.
steps: Find a vehicle worth registering.
Register it in the Scooter Bros app.
Repeat for 10 vehicles.
